messages:
Noah: quick note 18:00 UTC release preflight failed during final promote. deploy-bot blocked on artifact verify for `frontend-ui`.

deploy-bot: Promote blocked: frontend-ui@canary-20260310 -> checksum mismatch. expected sha256:777aaa... observed sha256:111bbb...

Noah: That's odd, build pipeline shows success and artifact uploaded once. Could be cache corruption on the registry side.

Priya: I saw a similar transient earlier today when pulling during a soak test. The CDN edge returned partial content for range requests.

ci-bot: Build #9347 finished at 17:40 UTC. Uploaded object: size=48,905,632 bytes, etag="multi-456". Registry responded 200, but HEAD returned x-index-version: 42 then later 41 on a subsequent verify.

infra-oncall: I'm checking the object-store logs. There was a background GC sweep at 17:42 that touched multipart temp keys. Possible race.

Noah: Immediate action: pin canary to last-known-good digest from staging smoke (sha256:777aaa0fdeadbeef), promote, run smoke. If green, hold release and escalate GC config.

Priya: Agree. I'll run the pin promote command and start a non-cache rebuild in parallel.

Priya: Executing:\n```\ndeploybot promote --service frontend-ui --image frontend-ui@sha256:777aaa0fdeadbeef --env canary --reason \"pin-after-checksum-mismatch\" --notify slack:eng-releases\n```

deploy-bot: Pin promotion ok: frontend-ui@sha256:777aaa0fdeadbeef -> canary.

ci-bot: Triggered rebuild pipeline #9349 with NO_REMOTE_CACHE=1.

Noah: Release-manager: please apply a manual hold on the cut and add stakeholders (product + legal) to the notification. We need a retrospective if GC touched active objects.

release-manager: Applied release hold. Notifying product and legal. Adding a 30-min hold window.

Priya: Smoke tests starting (quick navigation, auth, bundle sanity).

ci-bot: Smoke #9350: quick-nav=pass, auth=pass, bundle-integrity=pass. Latency within baseline.

Noah: Canary looks healthy. infra-oncall, do you want us to wait for rebuild upload to confirm digest matches before unblocking?

infra-oncall: Yes please. If rebuild uploads identical digest and registry HEAD is stable, remove hold. If not, we'll invalidate bad object keys and re-run compaction with safety flags. Filing INF-1705.

Priya: Rebuild finished. Upload digest: sha256:777aaa0fdeadbeef. Registry HEAD now consistent (x-index-version: 43).

infra-oncall: Confirmed. Identified root cause: GC job accepted temp part files during finalization window leading to ETag mismatch on some range reads. Mitigation: add finalization lock and bump temp TTL to 1h. Also add deploybot pre-promote HEAD re-check (2 retries).

release-manager: Follow-up ticket INF-1705 created: \"Object-store GC race -> partial reads during promote; add finalization lock + deploybot retries\" assigned to infra. ETA: patch in next deploy window.

Noah: Thanks. Removing manual hold, proceeding with staged promotes. Add a short blurb to release notes: \"Minor canary pin due to artifact verification transient; fixed by pinning and rebuild, no user impact.\"

Priya: Noted. Will keep monitoring for 30m. :eyes:
